purpose: Scripted replay of the four escrow lifecycle paths (runbook section 7 item 3) on Solana Devnet over the public RPC. Signatures can be checked on the Devnet explorer. Latency is wall-clock from send to 'confirmed' as seen by this client.
rpc_plan: public Solana Foundation Devnet RPC, free, no API key; published limits 100 requests / 10 s per IP, 40 / 10 s per method

params.rpc_client_throttle: requests >= 200 ms apart, same method >= 450 ms apart, 429 retried with backoff and counted per transaction (rpc_429 in txs.jsonl); dropped connections retried up to 6 times (net_retries); confirmation by polling getSignatureStatuses about every 0.45 s (no websocket), so ms_confirmed has a polling resolution of about 0.5 s and includes client-side queueing
